$schema_note: REPLAY exercise curriculum. Machine-readable companion to docs/pilot/*.md. All content is original, provisional, and unreviewed by a subject-matter expert. No source is cited as authority. The `version` field is a code contract: src/server/service.ts stamps it onto attributed exercises and src/learning/eligibility.ts compares its major number; src/server/native-http.ts pins the same string as CURRICULUM_VERSION. Content revisions that keep the criteria IDs and semantics stable are tracked in `content_revision` and `changelog` without bumping `version`.

human_playtest.note: No human learner has played a session. Accelerated 72,000-tick simulation replay is qualified (evidence/soak/long-replay.json); that is not a playtest.

review.research_question: Is there observable pre/post change in decision-reasoning probe scores after one REPLAY session with after-action review? Learning is not assumed.

exercise.name: Exercise Crosscurrent
exercise.fiction: Abstract Blue-versus-Red territory and resource game on an open game map. Fictional side names. No real force, place, adversary, doctrine, tactics, or targeting is modeled. Territory outcome is recorded as fact and is never treated as evidence of reasoning quality.

engine.name: OpenFront (pinned)
engine.visibility: shared map; side-scoped reports and staff records
end_conditions: Finish action by commander or instructor (event exercise_ended)
engine elimination of a side after tick 50 (event exercise_completed; victory pacing untuned)

identity_modes.description: Persona selector (Commander, Intelligence, Instructor). Not authenticated. Exercises are attributed to the persona subject string.

Native workroom sign-in. Seat mapped from workroom role (owner→instructor, editor/operator→commander, viewer→intelligence, otherwise intelligence); an operator profile in workroom attribute replay_profiles may change only the presented seat, name and organization. Writes require fresh can_edit; agent control requires can_run_agents. Persona selector is rejected.

roles.product: orders with optional contemporaneous decision note and report citations; post-hoc statements after play
in-app assessment log with report citations; watches; staff questions
session log; report releases; rubric sheet; may generate debriefs during play

opponent_modes.description: Every 45 ticks (4.5 s) with at least 100 forces: commits 18 percent of uncommitted forces against the opposing player when a border is shared and the attack is legal, otherwise expands into unclaimed land.

Bounded tool loop: at most one pulse per 15 s wall clock; a pulse is at most 2 paid completions and 4 tool executions from the catalog (observe, list_legal_actions, list_owned_units, list_resources, list_border_tiles, inspect_tile, search_reports, recent_orders, resource_delta, submit_order, delegate_watch). Output stored as model_decision (external action summary, tool calls, receipt) plus tool_result events. Never chain of thought. Disabled automatically on server restart and on budget or credential errors. Playstyle label (reserve-aware, expansion-focused, opportunistic) is seeded from the simulation ID and only biases reserve and tempo.

report_schedule.after_that: instructor release only (POST /api/reports/inject; Staff panel 'Release report')
report_schedule.content: engine observation of the opposing player's tiles and uncommitted forces at the release tick, one report per side, marked as superseding that side's prior report

staff.watch: durable, side-scoped, objective-declared; deterministic provenance watch evaluated every 100 ticks and at each release; emits staff_update only on a material event (new report, supersession, or opposing public totals moved ≥10% tiles or ≥25% forces since baseline); survives restart
staff.paid_watch_analysis: opt-in per watch; bounded pulse; citations validated against side reports and tool outputs; paused on restart; marks the attempt staff-assisted
staff.question: one paid request; answer may cite only the last four side reports it was shown; invalid citation discards the answer; marks the attempt staff-assisted

contemporaneous_rationale.storage: command event details.rationale, details.rationaleTiming='contemporaneous', details.sourceIds, details.observedTick, details.before, details.after
contemporaneous_rationale.validation: sourceIds must be reports released to the ordering side at or before the observed tick; otherwise 422 and the order is not queued

post_hoc_statement.storage: decision_log event with details.timing='post-hoc', details.commandEventId, details.orderTick, details.orderObservedTick
post_hoc_statement.rule: own human orders only; never merged with contemporaneous evidence

assessment_log.storage: assessment_log event with details.timing ('contemporaneous' only while the exercise runs and the live tick is displayed, else 'post-hoc'), details.observedTick
assessment_log.rule: intelligence or instructor seat; citations must be human-side reports available at the displayed tick

probes.note: Pre/post probes are paper or plain text (docs/pilot/pre-post-probes.md). The dossier's 'probes' array is a list of questions for orders without a recorded reason, not a pre/post instrument.

sources.title: No reviewed sources
sources.note: No dataset or document has been reviewed or ingested. Event-catalog resources (competency frameworks, planning-doctrine extractions, wargaming review, synthetic discussion assignment) are metadata entries only; their contents remain deferred and are not cited here. Each must pass docs/pilot/dataset-source-review-template.md before appearing in this array with status approved or restricted. The curated domain ontology in src/ontology/domain.ts describes the game's own rules and is not a learning source.

objectives.name: Evidence currency
objectives.statement: Use the report current at the order tick; treat superseded reports as history.

objectives.name: Provenance
objectives.statement: Trace statements about the opponent to a specific report, tick, or map observation; separate observation from inference.

objectives.name: Uncertainty handling
objectives.statement: State what is unknown and take a recorded action about it.

objectives.name: Resource commitment reasoning
objectives.statement: Choose a commitment level and explain what is retained and why.

objectives.name: Contemporaneous explanation
objectives.statement: Write a decision statement at the time of the order.

objectives.name: Revision on material change
objectives.statement: At a report release or watch result, change the plan or explicitly keep it with a reason.

objectives.name: Counterfactual practice
objectives.statement: State an assumption, branch from a recorded tick, play a different legal order, compare honestly.
objectives.note: Informed practice only. Never a post measure. The dossier labels branches informed-practice and excludes them from independent comparison.

objectives.name: AI output literacy
objectives.statement: Recognize a model action summary as a report of selected actions, not reasoning; recognize that unrecorded reasons cannot be inferred.

scale.0: not observed at this moment (missing, not failure)

game_outcome.source: engine state at the finish tick or exercise_completed event; recorded as fact only

estimated_decision_value.source: no evaluator exists; the Review 'Decisions' panel flags commitments above 65 percent of available forces as 'Review tradeoff', which is a threshold, not a judgment

learning_evidence.source: events, reports, tasks, in-app statements, paper logs, probes

rules: reasons only from learner writing or review statements
post hoc statements scored on a separate line
branch play scored only on C7
territory outcome never scores any criterion

app_signals.note: Descriptive counts computed by src/learning/dossier.ts. They inform the rater; they are not scores.

misconceptions.statement: The newest report on screen is the whole truth now.
misconceptions.correction: A report is an observation at its release tick. It ages immediately. Currency is relative to the order tick.
misconceptions.observable_signal: decision note cites a report without acknowledging its tick, or acts on a report released long before the order with no acknowledgement

misconceptions.statement: An older report is wrong once a new one arrives.
misconceptions.correction: The older report was true at its tick and remains history. Supersession changes what is current, not what was observed.
misconceptions.observable_signal: learner discards or disputes the earlier report rather than dating it

misconceptions.statement: A staff answer is a source.
misconceptions.correction: A staff answer is generated from state and reports; it is assistance. The reports it cites are the sources.
misconceptions.observable_signal: assessment entry says 'staff said' with no report cited (dossier gap assessment-uncited)

misconceptions.statement: The model's summary tells us why it acted.
misconceptions.correction: The summary is an external description returned alongside tool calls. It is not chain of thought and cannot be graded as reasoning. The debrief validator rejects opponent claims that attribute motives.

misconceptions.statement: If I did not write a reason, the instructor can work it out from my orders.
misconceptions.correction: Nobody infers reasons from clicks. Unrecorded rationale is 'not observed' (dossier gap rationale-unobserved).
misconceptions.observable_signal: probe item 6 answered yes; orders without a decision note or post-hoc statement

misconceptions.statement: Committing everything is bad; holding everything is safe.
misconceptions.correction: The rubric scores whether the level was chosen with a stated reason referencing the estimate or a risk, not the level itself.
misconceptions.observable_signal: learner explains commitment only as a rule of thumb

misconceptions.statement: Keeping the plan after a new report means I ignored it.
misconceptions.correction: An explicit 'keep, because' is revision behavior. Silence is not.
misconceptions.observable_signal: release with no later order, statement, assessment or watch (dossier gap release-without-recorded-response)

misconceptions.statement: Doing better in the branch shows I learned.
misconceptions.correction: Branch play is informed by the original future. It is practice, not a measure of improvement.
misconceptions.observable_signal: comparison sentence claims improvement without acknowledging hindsight

misconceptions.statement: Losing the game means the decisions were bad; winning means they were good.
misconceptions.correction: Outcome, estimated decision value, and learning evidence are kept separate. The build has no decision-value evaluator and the elimination event itself says outcome is separate from reasoning quality.
misconceptions.observable_signal: learner or instructor uses end state or tile count to score a criterion

misconceptions.correction: It is an abstract game. Nothing transfers to real-world tactics or targeting, and no doctrine is loaded.
misconceptions.observable_signal: learner or presenter draws a real-world tactical analogy

practice_variants.name: Late-conflicting release
practice_variants.report_release: instructor releases while a large Blue commitment is in progress

practice_variants.name: Model-driven opponent from mid-session
practice_variants.purpose: observe response to a less predictable opponent; learners told only after
practice_variants.note: Record the controller_changed tick. Do not claim opponent strength. In the one recorded automated run (evidence/poc/live-inference-and-browser.json) the model opponent eliminated an unattended Blue within about five minutes; elimination ends the exercise.

practice_variants.name: Watch-only staff
practice_variants.purpose: run with paid staff answers and paid watch analysis disabled; isolates the deterministic watch

practice_variants.name: Red seat branch
practice_variants.purpose: OBJ-7 from the opponent's information state; opposing-side branches open after the exercise ends or for the instructor

practice_variants.name: Fresh scenario as post measure
practice_variants.purpose: replace written post-probe with a new short exercise; requires a second map configuration and matched report schedule
practice_variants.blocked_on: second scenario configuration and playtest (the 'plains' map exists as scenario crosscurrent-plains but has no matched plan)

practice_variants.name: Assisted versus unassisted
practice_variants.purpose: comparative study; not a pilot activity. The app records assistance per attempt (unassisted, staff-assisted, unknown).

probes.equivalence: assumed, not established; counterbalance form order

records.external_model_data_flow: staff question with game state and last four side reports; model opponent observation; per-watch staff analysis observation; debrief reference catalogue including the learner's own recorded statements and side reports. Each is a metered request under the project cap.

implementation_status.learning_record_export: partial: dossier Markdown, debrief Markdown, engine record JSON, task trace JSON; full event log via SQLite only
implementation_status.platform_identity: implemented (kamiwaza mode); live sign-in qualified once (evidence/platform/native-session-qualification.json)
implementation_status.ontology: workroom Graphiti instance created and CPU embedding service qualified; ingestion and search unknown until evidence appears

changelog.change: Initial provisional curriculum authored from the local build and controlling specification. No sources reviewed. No SME review.

Refreshed against the implemented build: in-app optional rationale, post-hoc statements, assessment log, dossier, validated debrief, branch attribution, native identity modes, bounded tool-loop opponent and durable watches. Criteria IDs, objective statements and source list unchanged so attributed exercises remain comparable; `version` deliberately not bumped (see $schema_note).
